Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer had successfully retrieved the correct IMDb page for "Compliance" in Step 13 (which showed the correct title, director, and plot). Instead of synthesizing the answer based on this successful retrieval, the Planner incorrectly assumed the previous attempt to load the URL directly (which timed out) meant the information was unavailable. Consequently, the Planner issued redundant instructions to retry loading the same URL, ignoring the fact that the search results from Step 13 already contained all the necessary data to answer the user's question. This represents a failure to adapt to successful partial data retrieval and an inability to conclude the task when sufficient information was present.
